# THOUGHT Glyph Library — Fourth Set

This is the explicit **4th Set** of the THOUGHT Glyph Library.

- Stable set ID: `inshell.thought.glyph-library.set-04`
- Set version: `1`
- Members: exactly **3** background-tile SVG glyph fonts
- Ordered members: `tile-vertical-ledger`, `tile-column-relay`, `tile-humanist-smooth`
- Repertoire: 76 restricted characters per font, including metrics-only SPACE
- Default presentation: approved `tight-v1`
- Letter background: archived `inshell.colorfont.v1`
- Digit/punctuation background: white
- Glyph foreground: automatic black/white maximum contrast
- Package status: private; see both license files

These are SVG glyph manifests and render helpers, not OS-installable TTF/WOFF files.

Open `gallery.html`, then read `HANDOFF.md`, `REVIEW.md`, and `storage-model.json`.

Verify:

```sh
npm run verify
```
